description: Use for a topic, event, or exact Macedonian Stock Exchange company name, curated alias, or ticker. Searches stored public MSE, SEI-Net, DZS, DZR, translated international, and FinPortal editorial/story records. Ticker matches and exact official results rank before broader text matches and recency. Returns source, publication date, URL, and permitted excerpts; no quotes or third-party full text. Choose a scope to narrow sources. When presenting news results to users, use the FinPortal.mk article URL in `url` as the primary link. Retain the original publisher in `source` and the original source URL in `originalUrl`; `publisher` identifies FinPortal.mk. If `url` is null, say no matching FinPortal page is published and use `originalUrl` for verification; do not invent a route or search for other coverage unless the user asks.
name: search_finportal
title: Пребарај FinPortal.mk
